distinction: Is the local pattern fine parallel stripes or thin lines at one slant, or broad shapes? Fine slanted stripes push up.
positive: fine dark and light stripes and hairlines (striped shirts, zebra, bicycle spokes, wheel fork, clock hand, handlebar), mostly one slant
negative: wide thick bars and big curved bands (wheel rims, window frames, blinds) at the other orientations

distinction: a bold painted body part with a glossy curve (wheel arch, grille, lens) against a plain flat thing
positive: vehicle fronts, wheels, grilles, tractors, pinwheel; paint on curved metal
negative: street sign, space bar, telephone, one dog nose: plain flat or thin-lined man-made things

distinction: a narrow metal tube with small round loops, keys or guards on it held close up, against large smooth round enclosures and legged forms
positive: revolver and rifle barrel with trigger guard, oboe and flute keys, harmonica, ballpoint, trombone, poodle and guenon muzzle
negative: large round smooth enclosures and spidery forms: clock, steel drum, ladle, vault, potter wheel, tarantula, bird heads

distinction: A body edge against flat bright ground.
positive: Cuirass straps, bird tail on sky, dog on grass, bottles on white.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Is there a thick bold stroke (heavy letters), or a ring or fine zebra stripe? Heavy strokes push up.
positive: heavy bold lettering and thick dark bars on a plain ground (Yale, Marc, BARB, 110 numerals)
negative: rings, circled marks, zebra stripes, wheel rims, honeycomb thin walls: thin repeated structure

distinction: Separates a small or isolated figure against a contrasting ground (positive) from a flat close-up surface filling the frame (negative).
positive: Animals and objects set apart: ferret, indigo bunting, partridge, hares, badger, snowmobile, abacus, planetarium.
negative: Exactly s4:255's top photos: smooth plastic, cloth, scale, whistle, towel with watermarks.

distinction: a dense clump of small round bumps, in green, against warm thin-limbed forms on plain ground
positive: broccoli and other green clumped fractal masses; also tree-covered hills and a dome among trees
negative: warm brown/tan thin-limbed bodies on plain ground, rows of roasted birds, red-brown fur (impala, bighorn, fox, rotisserie)

distinction: a long tapered body seen side-on whose surface has parallel streaks along its length, against short round bodies with a circular central part
positive: feathered wings and flanks with parallel streaks (brambling, robin), boat hulls, leafhoppers, striped cat fur, a paddle
negative: round or squat bodies with a ring or opening on the front: mask, soap dispenser, coffee pot, trombone bell, fluffy white dogs, barometer

distinction: Thin straight lines against a contrasting field.
positive: Guitar strings, spokes, piano keys, wing feathers, leopard whiskers.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Small hard-edged dark-and-light hardware detail.
positive: Locomotive window band, telephone dial, padlock, tandem frame, photocopier panel.
negative: Not read.

distinction: a hand-made object on a plain ground against a furry face
positive: watch, laptop, kayak, rifle, hand blower: small man-made objects, weak firing (peak 2.1)
negative: dog faces (z -1.8) and a corn cob, a perforated board

distinction: a pointed pair of ears over a narrow muzzle, facing the viewer
positive: dog, fox, wolf, collie faces; a Polaroid camera front
negative: not read

distinction: Saturated orange or yellow patch.
positive: Macaw, bell pepper, lemon, sarong, king penguin patch.
negative: Dog faces and screens, at very low strength (-.5).

distinction: Is there a bold broad stroke, or fine repeated stripes? Bold strokes push up (weakly), fine periodic stripes push down.
positive: bold broad strokes and shapes: letters, skull, wheel spokes, keys, wide stripes
negative: dense fine periodic stripes (zebra, spider web, wrapped cord, iris threads): the pitch is too fine

distinction: Water or sky surface around the subject, against fine banded land animals.
positive: Underwater views, swimmers, sharks, whales, submarine, seashore: subject in water.
negative: Zebra, hourglass, fox, poodle, tree frog, viper: fine banded or furred land things.

distinction: Is there a thin curved arc or rim, or a filled round disc? Thin round rims push up, filled discs and soft round shapes push down.
positive: thin curved rims and arcs: bicycle wheels, bucket handle, wheel rims, brake lights, domes, eye rims, French horn tube
negative: filled soft round discs and plates: paper lanterns, CD, plates, round buttons, sea slug blob, bobsled helmet

distinction: a cluster of small round or oval bumps packed together
positive: olives, peas, lemons in a bowl, daisy centre, brain coral, knotted rope, pom-poms
negative: not read

distinction: Is there a short bright outline stroke or edge, or a long straight line? Short curved outline strokes push up, long straight lines push down.
positive: thin bright outlines of letters, logos and rims, repeated small stripes (zebra, mesh): many short edges close together
negative: long straight smooth lines crossing the crop (rails, wires, bars) and big rings at low contrast

distinction: a narrow tip or neck that tapers up from a wider body, standing upright
positive: bottle necks, spires, shaker caps, baby bottle teats, stupa, bell tower tops
negative: not read

distinction: thin dark straight lines that cross at an angle over a pale, bright ground
positive: bare twigs on sky, wires, music stand, chrome rim, panel edges, car roof edge, pan rim
negative: not read (stage 2 here: crops are tiny)

distinction: Is there a dark curved band across lighter bumpy or mixed texture? Weak. Mid-width curved bands push up.
positive: mixed texture with a curved dark band: honeycomb cells, bicycle brake cable, apples, goblet letters, blue chair bars
negative: not read

distinction: Separates a long, lean, tall-legged body (positive) from a low, round, bulky or heavily furred body (negative).
positive: Slender canids and lean animals, legs often in frame: borzoi, saluki, wolves, coyote, malamute, llama; short or smooth coat showing the legs.
negative: Stout round bodies: water buffalo, marmot, wombat, hippo, boxer, fluffy small dogs (Yorkie, Maltese, Shih-Tzu), plus violin, flute (thin things held to a face).

distinction: White surface, versus blue sky and hard-edged man-made things.
positive: White poodle, Samoyed, Saluki, egg, vulture head, white blossom.
negative: Blue sky scenes: lighthouse, planetarium, alp, castle, radio telescope.

distinction: Separates a broad, round, frontal head with ears or a big rounded furry mass (positive) from thin, narrow, pointed shapes (negative).
positive: Faces and heads of furry or big animals looking at the camera: cow, Rottweiler, snow leopard, retrievers, tabby, lynx, Newfoundland, elephant.
negative: Narrow pointed forms: toy terrier, Ibizan hound, storks, oystercatcher, turnstone, beaver, porcupine nose, wallaby face; also climber. Birds with a spike bill.

distinction: a round wheel set in a long smooth painted body (side view of a vehicle) against a soft centered face or radial bloom with a dark nose or eye-like middle
positive: side views of vans, fire engines, cabs, a go-kart: wheel plus flat body panel; top 16 are all vehicles with a visible wheel
negative: human and dog faces (nose, mouth), daisies and other flowers with a round centre; keeps out faces and radial organic shapes

distinction: Detects a plain smooth sky or ground with the edge of an object at the side.
positive: Tops of towers, mountains, crane, mast, a dog head cut off at the corner on a blue sky.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: thin straight parallel stripes of strong contrast
positive: zebra, picket fence, typewriter keys, clock hand, stripes on a sleeve, safety pin
negative: not read

distinction: Fine regular ridges and ribs wound around.
positive: Brain coral, ammonite, hose ribs, snake scales, baseball seams, typewriter bar.
negative: Not read.

distinction: a soft dark cover folded around a form, against a pointed or flat part sticking out of a body into open water or sky
positive: dark fabric wraps: gas mask hood, abaya, mortarboard gown, backpack, knee pad, scooter cover, bulletproof vest
negative: projecting appendages in open space: orca fin, dragonfly wings, airliner wing, beetle horn, seal flipper, spider legs

distinction: Not read: its sheet was made, not opened.
positive: Not read.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Large smooth painted or glazed surface with drawn decoration, against glass screens and rigid glossy things.
positive: Glazed jugs, teapots, mugs, graffiti-covered boxcars: a wide curved or flat painted face.
negative: Screens, bottles, helmets, jackfruit, brushes.

distinction: a thin pointed shape swept out against open sky or empty ground, against closed loops, grids and dark enclosed forms
positive: wing-spread planes and storks against sky, pen nib, snake head, hammerhead, bustard
negative: enclosed loops, grids and mesh: padlock shackle, waffle iron, gas mask, syringe, spatula, beetle, snowmobile

distinction: rigid straight lines meeting at an angle to make a triangular frame, against soft furry shapes with small pointed ears
positive: taut lines and A-frames: sailboat rigging, suspension bridge cables, tent edge, tripod, harp strings, mosquito net, pelican bill
negative: soft fur with small pointed ears: coyote, tabby, fox squirrel, Siamese cat, rabbit, brown bear, miniature pinscher

distinction: Pure white fluffy body, versus mid tan or brown body.
positive: Maltese, Samoyed, cockatoo, flamingo, spoonbill, a white airship.
negative: Tan, brown, grey-brown bodies: warthog, hare, meerkat, jackfruit, border terrier. Keeps out mid tan.

distinction: Dark thin hard edge on bright ground (bars, letters, grille).
positive: Grilles, prison bars, lettering, street signs, window frames.
negative: Round or curved saturated colour (lemons, banana, maraca, wheel).

distinction: Is there a small round ring or dot with an outline (a screw, a circled mark), or a straight thin line? Small rings push up (to 14), straight lines push down (to -12).
positive: small closed round outlines: circled (c), knob rings, screws, coins, round buttons, mushroom spots, neon circles
negative: long straight thin lines and strokes: spokes, hands, bridge wires, thin edges. Strong, -12.

distinction: Long narrow tapered muzzle, versus flat short squashed face.
positive: Wolf, red wolf, dhole, borzoi, Italian greyhound, whippet, dingo, grizzly.
negative: Flat short faces: Boston bull, pug, Shih-Tzu, Pekinese, Japanese spaniel, Angora, hamster.

distinction: a slender upright line standing alone in open space, against a short wide tube or bell seen close up
positive: thin vertical things on plain ground: impala legs, wheat ear, parking meters, flagpole-like bird box, flamingo, stork, camel legs, parachute line
negative: short wide hollow forms close up: trombone bell, microphone, oboe, planetarium, shaggy dogs, radiator

distinction: a short blunt front with paired dots or lights on top, against a long tube or long snout that extends away
positive: blunt fronts with two eyes or lights: hamster, mink, beaver, bird face, car and school-bus fronts, mouse, digital watch face
negative: long cylinders and long snouts: pen, projectile, cannon, Weimaraner, wolf, fish head, whistle

distinction: Warm saturated orange-red glossy surface.
positive: Fig, stew, agaric, crab, egg yolk, car window glare.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Dark solid body mass, against pale tan or white bodies.
positive: Black dogs, siamang, joystick, black abaya, hippo, elephant silhouette, fire smoke: dark mass.
negative: Tan bull mastiffs, whippets, polar bears, meerkat: light warm bodies.

distinction: Is there a tiny isolated dark dot (eye, hole, screw), or something else? Tiny dark dots on a lighter surface push up.
positive: tiny isolated dark dots on a lighter surface: eye of bird or cockatoo, screw holes, puck, dalmatian spots, pen dots, flying birds far away
negative: not read (sheet made, not opened)

distinction: Thin lines fanning out from a centre, versus dense dark bristle with a centre.
positive: Bolo tie, daisy petals, fan feathers, wheel spokes, a dome from below.
negative: Dense bristles: daisy centre, echidna, porcupine, Pomeranian face, macaque.

distinction: one smooth convex arc or dome, against small round dials with radial hands
positive: domes and arcs: fireboat water arcs, radio dish, planetarium, armadillo shell, iron, fountain, mountain tent
negative: round dials with spokes and hands: analog and wall clocks, cart wheel, brass plaque, dippers and ouzels with white breast

distinction: Detects a saturated pink or bright colour patch.
positive: Pink umbrella, jellyfish, lotion, handkerchief, picks, parachute, patterned skirt.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: Is the patch dark with a hard corner against light, or a small round spot? Large dark flat areas push up weakly.
positive: large dark flat regions with a hard edge: black clothing, tyre, dark panels, wheel well
negative: small round dark holes and dots on white (pen dots, skull eyes, bead holes, boat windows)

distinction: Fine ruled ticks or dial marks in a row, against furry round faces.
positive: Slide rules, scales, barometers, watch faces, salamander spots, streetcar windows: repeated small marks.
negative: Primate and dog faces, tusker, red panda, drain filter.

distinction: Long loose strands hanging in thin lines against a body, versus smooth blunt skin folds with no strands.
positive: Long hanging hair fringes and thin crossing lines: colobus tail, Afghan ears, Bernese coat, and also clock hands.
negative: Smooth short coat on a wide blunt wrinkled head (boxer, bull mastiff, pug), and an elephant's wrinkled trunk. Keeps out folds and smooth skin.

distinction: Is there a dark patch or heavy letter on white, or a smooth gradient? Dark bold patches on white push up.
positive: dark heavy letters and dots on white or pale ground (PHP, Cheese, dots on a lighter, bird silhouettes)
negative: smooth gradients and soft edges, fur, dark-to-light shaded surfaces

distinction: Long row of parallel straight bars, against thin spokes or wings on open background.
positive: Train sides and rails, piano keys, steel-drum rims, spoon rows: repeated parallel horizontal bands.
negative: Bicycle wheels and riders, warplanes in formation, soaring birds, crab legs, ladybug: thin diagonal spokes, wings, legs.

distinction: a smooth round rim or disc on a flat glossy surface
positive: wheels of vans, rims of cups, bottle necks, joystick: round smooth edge on plain surface
negative: not looked at

distinction: long thin blades or stalks laid across a darker textured ground
positive: grass and leaf blades, snake over leaves, fur whiskers, mushroom stem, flute
negative: not read

distinction: a small round or lettered mark on a smooth ground against fine irregular fur or mesh
positive: hub caps, letters, dials, eyes of birds: small bold mark on smooth ground
negative: fur, chainlink fence, honeycomb, hair, moss: dense fine irregular texture; keeps out fine texture

distinction: Is there a single dark round disc (pupil, polka dot, hole) in a lighter surround, bigger than s2:71's dot? Big dark discs push up.
positive: single dark round discs: cat pupil, polka dots, a sign circle, tomato slice hole, totem hole, trigger buttons, wheel hubs
negative: not read

distinction: one smooth, glossy, streamlined surface that sweeps in a single curve, against dense warm brown or red surfaces that are full of small parts
positive: smooth glossy bodies with one long curve: car bonnets, boat hulls, jet fuselage, shark and gator skin, plain white duvet. Blue-grey and white dominate
negative: warm brown/red/tan close-ups with rounded edges and detail (barn, red pan, cello, baseball, mortar, trilobite, isopod). Keeps out textured, small-part things

distinction: a smooth blank surface or soft blur against a furry face with eyes
positive: plain wall, painted car side, bib, perfume bottle, blurred feathers: low-texture areas; also two dog close-ups with grey fur
negative: frontal dog faces and a gibbon face; keeps out furry eyed faces

distinction: Separates a small sharp bright thing set against a soft blurred green field (positive) from a sharp full-frame detail or texture (negative).
positive: Small or isolated coloured subject (bird, child's hand, ice lolly, kart, bill and eye) against out-of-focus green or fence; indigo bunting, black stork, grasshopper.
negative: Hard detail filling the frame or a pale/dark texture: junco, green mamba scales, screws, basket weave, Siamese cat face, candle flames, beagle on pavement.

distinction: Are there many dense horizontal parallel bars (louvres, grille slats)? Dense horizontal bars push up.
positive: dense horizontal bars and ridges: grille, vent slats, accordion, coils, striped shirt, steam locomotive grille
negative: not read (sheet made, no image opened)

distinction: Slim body alone in open empty space, against close frontal faces and screens.
positive: Kite, storks, eagle, ostrich, crane, radio telescope, balloon: a thin object on empty sky or ground.
negative: Pug and bulldog faces, monitors, laptops, goblet, guitar: close filled frontal view.

distinction: Separates dark spots scattered on a pale coat or skin (positive) from one even colour, a smooth sheen or a fine mesh (negative).
positive: Spotted or ticked coats: Dalmatian, English setter, bluetick, Great Dane, snow leopard, hyena, German pointer, an ox.
negative: Plain warm-brown coat (Rhodesian ridgeback, vizsla, malinois, Chesapeake), spirals, mesh, foam, even-coloured leather.

distinction: a repeated small pattern (scales, dots, keys, bands) against a furry face
positive: snake skin, accordion keys, ladybug, spider, keypad: regular repeated marks
negative: dog and monkey faces (z -5.1, deepest of the set); keeps out faces

distinction: Detects long straight edges with plain ground on both sides.
positive: Tower, mast, church spire, modem edge, jersey edge, dog's muzzle in side view.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: Smooth far-away slope or ridge edge filling the frame, against small glossy near objects.
positive: Distant hills, volcano cones, valley walls and snow slopes: one big smooth diagonal ridge.
negative: Small glossy hand-sized things with round or whistle shapes (toys, balls, whistles, dials) and furry faces.

distinction: Separates thin strands or bars crossing a plain ground, including long shaggy hair (positive), from smooth, sleek, closed surfaces (negative).
positive: Shaggy coats and thin frames: komondor, Lhasa, Bouvier, Old English sheepdog, rickshaw wheels, chair legs, wheelbarrow, warplane gear, shopping cart.
negative: Smooth sleek bodies: whippet, gazelle, impala, miniature pinscher, Doberman, borzoi, egret, balloon-like shapes (soccer ball, perfume bottle, bikini).

distinction: Is the stripe pitch very fine (one or two pixels) and parallel, or wide? Fine parallel stripes push up strongly.
positive: the finest parallel stripe patterns at any slant: zebra, vacuum hose coils, accordion, honeycomb ridges, fire engine slats, bikini edge
negative: wider stripes (striped shirts), text and rings at normal pitch

distinction: Is there a small dark round dot on a plain light ground, or a thin dark stroke? Dot pushes up, thin stroke pushes down.
positive: isolated small dark dots and round holes on light ground: eyes, skull sockets, pen dots, punctuation, bold letter blobs
negative: thin dark strokes and hairlines on light ground (script writing, twigs, clock hands): the opposite of a dot is a line

distinction: Is there a bold bright vertical or slanted bar on a dark ground, or a thin ring or hairline? Bold bars push up, thin curved lines push down (large negative values).
positive: bold bright strokes on dark: thick letters (Model T, DEAD), tow truck stripes, clock numerals, neon letters
negative: very strong negative on thin ring outlines and hairlines (rings, ruler ticks, gown seam, neon thin lines)

distinction: Many parallel straight strands in a bundle, versus pebbly dimpled short surface.
positive: Brush bristles, paintbrush, broom, wig, komondor cords, pelican feather, sloth hair.
negative: Dimpled or stippled short surface: golf ball, koala fur, shield, beetle, doormat. Keeps out dimples.

distinction: Thin open frame holding a flat panel (seat, sail, basket), against filled round blobs.
positive: Shopping carts, rickshaws, barber chairs, thrones, sailboats and sails, steel drums.
negative: Spiders, balls, pill bottle, cheeseburger, plunger: filled round or radiating shapes.

distinction: a smooth empty field with a thin edge object entering at its border
positive: plain blue sky or plain background, with a pole, wire, shaker or hull entering at an edge
negative: not read

distinction: Separates a huge, smooth, thick-skinned body (positive) from fine wiry hair and small thin parts (negative).
positive: Grey whale, elephant (tusker), turtle, hippo, bison: dark wet hide, tails, big heads half out of water.
negative: Wiry or fine-detail things: standard schnauzer, Dandie Dinmont, affenpinscher, gallinule, vulture, keyboard, reel, beetles.

distinction: A jet or plume spreading out from a point, against round smooth closed shapes.
positive: Geyser plumes, fountains, wave splash, steam, fire-boat jets, killer whale spray: a V or fan of white.
negative: Round smooth closed things: car wheel hub, pill bottles, bubble, nipple, carousel, ostrich head.

distinction: Are there thin separate lines or wires meeting at an angle, or dense regular ridges? Thin lines at junctions push up, dense ridges push down.
positive: thin separate edges forming junctions: chain-link fence, violin strings, clock hands, wire harness, buckle, ruler corner, kite wing feathers
negative: dense regular ridges: vacuum hose coils, typewriter ridges, compass ticks, ruler marks, honeycomb, comb teeth

distinction: Detects long thin edges lying across a plain ground, like feathers, spokes or ties.
positive: Wing feathers, cart wheel, bow tie, pineapple scales, tail, knife blade.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: Fine check or woven pattern on a body, against plain.
positive: Plaid shirts, gingham, toaster, rugby ball, newt, fur: small repeated texture.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Smooth warm red-brown bare body, versus white-and-black high contrast pattern.
positive: Redbone, ridgeback, Irish setter, sorrel horse, bare skin in bikini photos, unicycle leg.
negative: White and black pattern: polar bear, husky, malamute, clock, toucan, dumbbell, snow scenes.

distinction: Pale cream-white body, versus dark solid brown body.
positive: White or cream: polar bear, cockatoo, egret, pale Labrador, white poodle.
negative: Dark chocolate or orange solid colour: chocolate and black Labrador, orange fruit, ferret, beaver. Keeps out dark brown.

distinction: Warm orange or russet patch on a body, versus black or very dark body.
positive: Red-orange: proboscis monkey face, ladybug, goldfish, merganser head, fox-coloured dog.
negative: Black or very dark: black bear, black Affenpinscher, black pug, buffalo, otter. Keeps out black.

distinction: Detects a pointed-ear head with tan muzzle facing the camera.
positive: Dingo, cairn, red fox, dhole, red wolf, gazelle, impala, basset, beagle, lesser panda.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: Detects printed letters, digits and marks on a surface.
positive: Text and logos on laptop, phone, odometer, book jacket, helmet, digital clock.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: Is there a very fine bright curl, tooth or stripe, or a round ring? Fine curls and teeth push up, rings and discs push down.
positive: finest repeated bright lines and teeth: zebra stripes, comb teeth, wing feather tips, logo curls, game-pad symbols
negative: round rings, circles and discs (keyboard keys, joystick dots, owl eye, bold letters)

distinction: Separates a bright, clean shape on a contrasting ground (positive) from a brown mottled mid-tone mass (negative).
positive: Glowing digits and dials on dark, and clean white or pale dogs on coloured ground: digital clock, scale, stopwatch, kuvasz, Eskimo dog, Arctic fox, grey parrot.
negative: Brown mottled things: wood rabbit, dung beetle, limpkin, Airedale, grouse, dingo, bighorn, frog.

distinction: a single tall or sky-backed structure against a furry eyed face
positive: towers, lighthouses, chimneys, airship, umbrella on open sky; also two dog photos
negative: dog faces plus one fox face and one human face; keeps out faces

distinction: tight parallel ridges that curve (coil, bellows, fan) against straight dense lines
positive: typewriter, spring, hose, fan palm, fish fin, accordion: curved ribs
negative: compass dial, mesh, striped sock, blinds: straight dense lines or grids

distinction: Separates a flat, smooth, near-uniform surface filling the frame (positive) from a body with thin limbs sticking out of a compact core (negative).
positive: Close-ups of smooth plastic, cloth, metal or a product face, no limbs, often a shop watermark across the photo; whistles, sleeping bag, towel, scale, safe.
negative: Bodies with outlines and appendages on a ground: harvestmen, spiders, beetles, ticks, and dogs (Boston bull, schnauzer, kuvasz, beagle). Dogs sit with the leggy bugs, not with cats.

distinction: Curled or wavy loops of strand, versus straight sleek smooth short coat.
positive: Spaniel and poodle ears and curls, chain links, rope knots, siamang fur.
negative: Sleek short coats and radiating spikes: Weimaraner, pug, Rhodesian ridgeback, starfish, spider, fan blades.

distinction: a vivid saturated colour patch that differs strongly from the colours around it
positive: purple, magenta, yellow and blue patches: toy, bottle, pretzel, anemone, parrot, mask
negative: not read (neg sheet not looked at)

distinction: Pale matte white sheet or roll, against nothing named.
positive: Paper towels, tents, yurts, lab coats, white sails, bee boxes.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Is there a small bright spot in the dark, or a flat uniform area? Bright spots on black push up.
positive: small bright lights and bright letters on black: stage lights, candle, sparks, street lights, white text on black
negative: flat uniform surfaces: grey wall, dark cloth, soft shadow gradient, the bottom border

distinction: Detects a regular criss-cross lattice of thin lines laid across the scene.
positive: Chain-link fence, in front of animals (cougar, wallaby, gibbon, squirrel monkey), padlock and chain.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: Detects four-legged body seen from the side on a ground.
positive: Dogs on lawn: Leonberg, Rottweiler, collie, wild boar, bear, dingo, rat, dowitchers with legs in view.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: Is the patch a smooth broad surface (curved, plain, shaded) or small bold print? Smooth surfaces push up, bold print and rings push down.
positive: smooth broad coloured surfaces and gentle curves: fig, pumpkin, camera barrel, loafer, red paper, thimble, clothing
negative: bold print and ring patterns: rings on cloth, lettering, keyboard keys, remote buttons, dials

distinction: Warm dark silhouette shapes with sharp steps against a glow.
positive: Staircase, throne bust, pier railing, drilling platform at dusk, honeycomb.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Detects a small pale blob on a darker area, near a dark edge.
positive: White paws, ping-pong ball, pale muzzle, dalmatian spot, candle flame, white feet of dogs.
negative: Not opened.

distinction: A long smooth drape falling in one piece, versus small hard compact parts.
positive: Gowns, cloaks, abaya, Afghan ear, long wig hair, lizard on a trunk.
negative: Small hard items: mouse, phone, iPod, bottle, comb, Boston bull face. Keeps out compact things.

distinction: Rounded curved warm brown or metal body parts in close crop.
positive: Trombone, throne post, bull mastiff legs, brass finial, weasel fur.
negative: Not read.

distinction: soft organic bloom or fur patch (radial or furry mass) against the man-made channels' side
positive: dog nose, gibbon, thistle, daisy, sunflower pictures, pelican bill: furry or petal mass, not cars
negative: not looked at

distinction: Smooth narrow front face with a dark nose, versus fluffy-ruffed face.
positive: Dingo, toy terrier, red wolf, whippet, Doberman, Great Pyrenees front face.
negative: Ruffed faces: collie, papillon, Pomeranian, Eskimo dog, gibbon.

distinction: Pale cream face of a dog or sheep.
positive: Labrador, Saluki, whippet, dalmatian, bighorn, Great Pyrenees faces.
negative: Not read.

distinction: Flat blank sky or bright smooth field.
positive: Blue sky, white sky, plain background.
negative: Not read.

distinction: a narrow shape that tapers into a pale or open region at the edge of the view
positive: dog snouts at the frame edge, flute, bridge arches, tower, camera barrel, scooter handle, croquet hoop
negative: not read

distinction: a small round saturated blob sitting on a contrasting ground
positive: berries, tomatoes, red dots on a joystick, balls, ladybug, strawberry on cream
negative: not read

distinction: Is the patch saturated green, or any other colour? Pure bright green pushes this channel strongly down; other colours push it up weakly.
positive: weak: neutral or warm surfaces with edges (gray, tan, clock face, text)
negative: saturated green of any shape: green lights, vine, green umbrella, beetle, green kitchen items

distinction: Head with two upright pointed ears on a front face.
positive: Collie, Australian terrier, Groenendael, Eskimo dog, hyena, toy terrier.
negative: Not read with a sheet.

distinction: Rounded body with limp lobes or thin legs hanging from it, versus upright compact pointed things.
positive: Floppy-eared spaniels and hounds, a spider's legs, clock hands, a dial phone with its cord.
negative: Erect-eared or upright forms: wallaby, Westie, rabbit, scooter, crab. Keeps out upright points.

distinction: Detects dark patches scattered on a lighter ground.
positive: Dalmatian, setter, ladybug, snake skin, goose bill, Doberman, Rottweiler tan marks, mantis.
negative: Not opened.
